caption:
Apparently everyone already knows these songs except me 🤦‍♀️
6 new songs to learn for House Band this week, so I will be listening to each of them approximately 6,000 times until the melody and lyrics become part of my brain.
Thank you Spotify for your service!
The touring musician dream currently looks like A LOT of homework and pushing repeat. 
Which of these do you already know?

#schoolofrock #bandpractice #musicianlife #youngmusician #aspiringmusician

Writing a song in my bedroom is one thing. Letting people hear it is a whole other thing. Suddenly it’s not just a melody in my voice memos but someone else is hearing something I felt. 

I’ve written more than 30 songs and I’m still figuring out which ones I love. I love this one. 

Someday I want a room full of people singing my songs with me. But first I have to get them out in the world. Here’s a little piece of Lavender Moon which was inspired by a night with my friends and their amazing dog named Lavender Moon and then I imagined her as a troubled Hollywood starlet and this story emerged! Haha writing is so fun.

 #aspiringmusician #youngmusician #youngsongwriter

Someday I want to tour the world playing my own songs. Right now, I have biology homework 😂

I’m 14, I’m homeschooled, and this is a pretty normal Friday for me. School, singing, piano, mixing, writing songs, and practicing songs. Lots and lots of practice.

I have two shows this weekend and an original I’m hoping to play at an open mic on Tuesday, so there’s a lot I’m excited about. And did I mention practice? 😂

Some of my stuff sounds good. Some of it needs A LOT more tries.

I don’t know exactly how you go from making music in your room to playing your own tour, but I’m trying to figure it out. One new song, one rehearsal, so much practicing and one very long Friday at a time 🎸

Anyone else trying to fit a big dream around schoolwork?

#songwriter #aspiringmusician #youngartist

I’m 14 and my dream is to become a touring musician.

Like actually touring. Playing my own songs. My own shows. My own band. A tour bus with a gear trailer. Opening for artists I love. All of it.

By the time I’m 16, I want to be playing my own shows in 300–500 person venues.

Which feels kind of crazy to type! But I really, really want to try.

The moment when I realized how badly I wanted this was when I saw @sadiejean in Berkeley.

I remember seeing the tour bus and the gear trailer outside and then being inside watching everyone sing along and dance to HER songs.

Songs she wrote that were now out in the world and meant something to all these people.

And I  thought…

I WANT THIS.

I want to write songs in my bedroom and someday hear a room full of people singing them back to me.

I want people dancing and screaming lyrics with their friends. I want my shows to be ridiculously fun. I want people to leave feeling happy and understood and like they just had the best night.

I remember being at the Eras Tour and looking around at SO many people who felt connected to Taylor’s music. Thousands of people feeling like her songs understood them.

I want to make people feel like that.

Especially girls my age who are growing up and trying to figure themselves out at the exact same time I am.

Right now, I’m reaching out to local events to try and get on their performance roster, I’m in the School of Rock House Band, I play guitar and keys, I take lessons, and I write songs constantly.

But I have NO IDEA how you actually get from here to there. 

How do you go from open mics and farmer’s markets to touring?

How do you find your band?

How do you get strangers to care about a song you wrote in your bedroom??

Great questions. I have no idea.

I just know I want this more than anything.

#youngmusician #songwriter #bendoregon #aspiringmusican

So I’m going to try.

And I guess we’re about to find out what happens. 🎸

We came back to Bend for a few months during hurricane season, and we thought we were going to return to the boat.
But somewhere along the way, music started changing the plan.
I started performing every week, met some incredible musicians, a lot of new friends and basically moved into @bendschoolofrock 😂, THEN I found out I made House Band.
So after three years of living and traveling on a sailboat, my family made a pretty huge decision:
We’re staying.
I’m 14, I write songs, I sing, I play guitar and piano, and my dream is to become a touring musician someday.
I have absolutely no idea where this is going to lead.
But I’m going to give it everything I’ve got.
So I guess this is Day 1. 🎸

For the past 5 1/2 years I have lived abroad and traveled a lot. Living this life means meeting lots of new people and making lots of new friends. I have a best friend name Lyla who travels a lot too. One night on a zoom call at 10pm we composed this song about what it’s like meeting new friends abroad. How you can be total strangers, but then in such a short time, it’s like you were never strangers! This is, “Strangers,” re-recorded without the jet ski!

Destroyed is a song I wrote about a very difficult friendship. Even though the events that inspired this song happened a long time ago, it’s still something I think about very day. I am trying to improve as a writer and have changed a few lines to include more details… more showing less telling. I’d love to know what you think!
